citation: Rodrigues G., Garcia N.M. Evaluating remote photoplethysmography: a 10-minute video dataset in uncontrolled lighting. Data in Brief 61 (2025) 111888. doi:10.1016/j.dib.2025.111888  (dataset doi:10.17632/bx8982xgwt.1, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

quality_gates.note: unchanged for this dataset; failures yield bpm=None

excluded_subjects.provider_documentation: article §4.7 states Subject_4 was excluded before release for persistent tracking failure and non-physiological ECG peaks
excluded_subjects.adapter_derived_evidence: all ROI videos are 0 bytes (empty placeholder files)

limitations: 26 participants (Subject_4 excluded by the provider), predominantly young Portuguese university students; Fitzpatrick I–IV only (no V/VI). No generalisation beyond this population.
Single-site acquisition: one room, natural indoor daylight, 10:00–16:00, one webcam type, participants seated and asked to stay still. No claim about other lighting, motion or devices.
64×64 ROI crops with consumer compression: fine pulsatile detail is limited by the provider's anonymisation pipeline, not by this implementation.
Video/ECG synchronisation is manual with a documented uncertainty of up to ±500 ms; this protocol therefore evaluates 30 s windows, not sub-second timing.
The ECG reference is a pulse-rate reference derived from R-peaks. Agreement with it is NOT validation of pulse-rate variability, HRV, or any clinical parameter.
Non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): results are research-use only and share-alike terms apply to redistribution of derived data.

descriptive_ungated._note: Descriptive sensitivity analysis computed after the frozen protocol ran: these are the same spectral peaks WITHOUT the quality gates. They are not rPPG-10 results and must not be quoted as such; compare them with the gated numbers to see what the gates remove.

combined_roi_descriptive._note: Descriptive only. 'ungated_combined_roi' averages the three ROI estimates of the same window (provider-comparable: their baseline uses a combined ROI over non-overlapping 30 s windows); 'gated_combined_roi' uses only windows that survived the frozen quality gates. Neither is a validation result and neither may be quoted as this project's accuracy.
